data: What is the accuracy of the red line when trained for 10 epochs?

The red line represents the average accuracy of 100 randomly initialized models trained on SST-2 (sentence-only). To determine the accuracy of the red line when trained for 10 epochs, we need to look at the position of the red line on the y-axis corresponding to 10 epochs on the x-axis.

From the figure, the red line appears to be around 86% when trained for 10 epochs. This can be verified by observing the position of the red line relative to the y-axis scale.
